cab_by_sector.label: cab_by_sector

net_liquidity_change_pct.label: Balance-sheet liquidity Δ% per ten-day step

jgb_purchases_month_to_date.label: Outright JGB purchases in the month judged (100m yen)

jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct.label: JGB purchases (projected month) vs plan

holdings_vs_expected_path.label: JGB holdings − expected path (519.9 tn → ~480 tn by 2027-03-31)

jgb_purch_settled.label: Outright JGB purchases by operation — FACE, at Date of Exercise (T+1)

ops_net_daily.label: BoJ operations net by operation (face; start + / end −)
